In a famous therapeutic application, Isaiah prescribed a fig cake poultice for King Hezekiah's boil (2 Kgs 20:7; Isa 38:21). The Greek equivalent palatha and Aramaic devilta confirm fig pressing as a widespread Near Eastern food technology."
